title: Illinois Condominium — Resale Disclosures
help: Current-effective statewide Illinois infrastructure for owner resales under Section 22.1. Statutory disclosure categories, response timing, fee framework, and lender-notice duty are Infrastructure; unit-specific requests, package references, dates, contacts, and charges are association-instance data.

pages.title: Resale Disclosures
pages.help: Current Section 22.1 infrastructure and association-instance tracking for unit-owner resales.

sections.title: Statewide resale framework
sections.help: These rules apply to a resale by a unit owner other than the developer under the current-effective text of Section 22.1.

controls.text: On resale of a condominium unit by a unit owner other than the developer, the owner must obtain the Section 22.1 information from the board and make it available for inspection to a prospective purchaser upon demand.
The principal officer or other specifically designated officer must furnish the required information when requested in writing and within 10 business days of the request.

The association or board may charge the unit seller a reasonable fee covering direct out-of-pocket cost. The statute establishes a $375 base cap subject to annual CPI-U adjustment beginning one year after the 2023 amendment's effective date; the current cap therefore follows the statutory indexing formula rather than a permanently fixed dollar amount.
The association may charge an additional $100 for rush service completed within 72 hours.

Within 15 days after recording a mortgage or trust deed against a unit to secure a debt, the unit owner must inform the board of the lender's identity and a mailing address at which the lender can receive association notices.

sections.title: Current statutory disclosure inventory
sections.help: Section 22.1 currently identifies nine disclosure categories. The collection-policy item enacted by P.A. 104-734 is future-effective January 1, 2027 and is not included in this current inventory.

controls.text: Current-effective Section 22.1(a) contains 9 resale disclosure categories.

controls.label: Disclosure package items
controls.help: Track the association's current source/reference for each statutory disclosure category. This inventory does not require one portal, document format, or storage system.

options.label: Declaration, bylaws, other condominium instruments, rules and regulations
Anticipated capital expenditures — current or succeeding 2 fiscal years
Reserve replacement fund status, amount, and earmarks
Statement of financial condition — last available fiscal year
Pending suits or judgments involving the association
Association insurance coverage provided for unit owners
Good-faith compliance statement for prior improvements or alterations
Principal officer or designated notice recipient identity and mailing address

item_controls.label: Document / data reference
item_controls.help: Reference or locator for the current source used to prepare this disclosure category.

sections.title: Resale request administration
sections.help: Unit-specific resale requests are association-instance events. Unit designators remain local references rather than statewide civic identity.

controls.label: Principal officer / designated resale contact
controls.help: Association-specific identity and mailing/contact information for the officer or agent designated to furnish Section 22.1 information.

controls.label: Current fee schedule / CPI calculation reference
controls.help: Reference showing how the association determined its current ordinary Section 22.1 fee under the statutory CPI-U indexing formula.

controls.label: Resale requests
controls.help: Track written requests and fulfillment without converting a unit label or seller identity into Infrastructure.

sections.title: Lender notice administration
sections.help: The owner has the statutory notice duty; the association may retain the resulting lender information as association-instance data.

controls.label: Lender notices
controls.help: Track lender notices received from unit owners under Section 22.1(c).
